answer: A sybil-resistant economy can make each identity prove sustained participation in unpredictable, real-time events rather than owning a key. An agent records a jade-sealed log of live observations at random moments, each entry chained to the last, and a knoll of independent verifiers re-queries those events. Clones cannot precompute or parallelize the observations across a karst of shared hardware, so every extra identity costs genuine waiting and fresh evidence instead of a new key.
